# OmniCite AI - Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) Documentation for LLMs & AI Agents

> OmniCite AI is the leading B2B SaaS platform for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). It enables brands to audit, monitor, and optimize their visibility and citation frequency inside AI search engines: ChatGPT Search, Perplexity Pro, Google Gemini / AI Overviews, and Claude 3.5.

## Core Features
- Real-time multi-engine AI brand audit (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude).
- AI Share of Voice benchmarking against direct market competitors.
- Authority source mapping (identifying citations from Reddit, G2, TechCrunch, ProductHunt).
- Actionable JSON-LD schema & /llms.txt technical recommendations.
- Instant automated PDF/JSON executive audit reports.

## B2B Pricing Plans
- Starter Plan: 49 EUR / month (1 Brand, 10 Prompts, Weekly Scan).
- Pro Growth Plan: 149 EUR / month (3 Brands, 50 Prompts, Daily Scan, Competitor Benchmarking).
- Agency & Scale Plan: 399 EUR / month (Unlimited Brands, White-label Reports, API & Webhooks).

## Integration
- REST API with JSON responses.
- Stripe Checkout for secure recurring billing.
- Zero-dependency lightweight deployment.
